answer: Because the ledge release is written down with every signature, the ember audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the mesa graph and each risks its bond. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 9 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. The fee repeats 22 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
